subject: Security attestation coordination + term amendment for upcoming renewal
messages:
From: Alison Reed <alison@tetonhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Chu <michael.chu@tetonhealth.com>; procurement@tetonhealth.com
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal timeline & security evidence requests

Sean / Marissa —

Hope you had a good week. Our renewal for Q2 is up for review and security has asked for a short re-attestation of SOC 2 controls covering the past 12 months. They specifically want:

- A recent SOC 2 snapshot / attestation letter (if available)
- Evidence for retention and audit log policies (how logs are retained and exported)
- Any changes to data access controls since our last attestation

Also, procurement is asking about term changes — we had discussed a potential 15% capacity uplift and an 18-month term to lock pricing. Can you confirm what you need from us to move forward (docs, signatures, and timing)?

We'd like to have this wrapped before our executive renewal review on Apr 15.

Thanks,
Alison
Director of IT Security
Teton Health

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Alison Reed <alison@tetonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal timeline & security evidence requests

Hi Alison — thanks for the clear asks. Short answers up front: yes — we can provide the SOC 2 snapshot and a curated evidence bundle, and we can propose an amendment for the 18-month term with a 15% committed capacity increase.

Plan / immediate next steps:
1) I attached a current SOC 2 snapshot (redwood_soc2-snapshot-2026-07.pdf) and an audit-log retention matrix template for your reviewers.
2) Monica will assemble the evidence folder (system configs, access review exports, and recent change logs). Expect an initial Drive share by EOD Wednesday.
3) Marissa will draft the contract amendment (term + capacity + pricing) and share a DocuSign link once we have commercial signoffs.
4) Vivek is copied for executive escalation if procurement needs SLA exceptions or an exception to our standard retention window.

If your security team prefers, we can do a 30-minute walkthrough next week of the evidence bundle and retention/export options. What time zones work best for you?

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attach: redwood_soc2-snapshot-2026-07.pdf; audit-log-retention-matrix.xlsx

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Teton Health evidence bundle & commercial prep

Marissa / Monica —

Quick internal note to align what we submit:
- Monica: prioritize export of audit log retention policies (kafka S3 lifecycle policies, CloudTrail retention, and our access logging for the inference runtime). Add a CSV of sample exports (past 90 days) and describe export process for auditors.
- Marissa: prepare amendment that keeps price flat for the 18-month term if they commit to the 15% capacity uplift (monthly committed token units). Add a clause for data residency and an option to opt into longer log retention at additional cost (procurement asked about that).
- Vivek: if procurement pushes for a longer retention window without incremental fees, we may need an SLA credit or a limit on egress — loop you if needed.

Target deliverables: evidence Drive link (Wed EOD), amendment draft (Fri). I will offer a walkthrough slot for Thu or Mon with Alison's security team.

Thanks,
Sean

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alison Reed <alison@tetonhealth.com>, procurement@tetonhealth.com
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Draft amendment and pricing for RDW-4531 (attached)

Alison / procurement —

Attaching a first draft of the amendment (amendment-draft-RDW-4531.docx). Summary of commercial terms in the draft:
- Term: 18 months (auto-renew opt-out at 30 days)
- Capacity: +15% committed GPU/token capacity tier, billed monthly at the committed rate
- Pricing: current unit prices maintained for the 18-month term; overages billed at standard OD rate
- Optional add-on: extended audit log retention (up to 24 months) at a fixed per-GB monthly fee

Next steps: please review and comment directly in the doc. Once we align on language, I'll generate a DocuSign envelope and link the evidence Drive folder in the signing email.

Attachments: amendment-draft-RDW-4531.docx

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Alison Reed <alison@tetonhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Chu <michael.chu@tetonhealth.com>, procurement@tetonhealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 14:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security attestation coordination + term amendment for upcoming renewal

Thanks everyone — we reviewed the materials with our security and procurement teams this morning. A few items:

- SOC 2 snapshot: looks good; our auditors requested a short note describing the scope (production inference endpoints only vs. batch internal tooling). Can you add a 1-paragraph scope statement to the Drive folder?
- Audit logs: sample exports were helpful. Security asked whether log retention is immutable (can logs be deleted earlier than retention policy). Please include the retention enforcement description and any scheduled lifecycle rules.
- Amendment: procurement wants the 15% uplift but asks that the optional extended retention be priced as a line item rather than a tiered add-on. Please update the doc. We should be ready to sign pending the scope paragraph and amended pricing line.

Would appreciate the updated scope paragraph and the revised amendment by Wednesday EOD so we can run it through our legal before the Apr 15 exec review. Also, please include the DocuSign link in your update.

Best,
Alison Reed
Director of IT Security
Teton Health

On Mon, Apr 12, 2027 at 09:18 AM Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the quick review, Alison. Monica and Marissa are on the scope paragraph and pricing update — expect an update by EOD Wednesday and I will open a DocuSign envelope then.
>
> -Sean
